progress.summary: Slice 17 was visually approved. A new motion-bridge and semantic-transit request exceeds the active contract; its unexecuted tail remains paused pending approval of the superseding proposal.

expectedLearning: Whether one usable-viewport authority can synchronize ordinary-document entry, exact scroll state, and direct semantic navigation without per-scroll layout work.
allowedWork: Economics two-column passage geometry, framework-neutral pure viewport and navigation helpers, and scoped tests.
disallowedWork: Semantic graph changes, catalog-wide visual rollout, and unrelated project work.
